sentences.text: Steven Price -LRB- born 22 April 1977 -RRB- is a British film composer , best known for scoring Gravity , which won him the Academy Award for Best Original Score .	British	United Kingdom	Gravity	Gravity (film)	Academy Award for Best Original Score	Academy Award for Best Original Score

Before making his debut as a composer with Attack the Block , he worked on the music department for various notable films , such as The Lord of the Rings : The Two Towers , The Lord of the Rings : The Return of the King , Batman Begins , and Scott Pilgrim vs. the World .
